title: CertificationLifecycleEvents
description: Certifications service domain events (v1), carried in the platform event envelope 'data' field. Published AFTER the primary write commits (a publish failure never fails a committed write); consumers must be idempotent on the envelope id. Five event types (design decision D10, user-approved): the three reserved in contracts/README plus CertificationRejected and CertificationExpiringSoon, so the future Notifications unit finds every US-8.15 certification trigger already flowing without this service being reopened. Points are NEVER reversed by Revoked/Expired — the `pointsReversed: false` constant makes that contract explicit for Contributions (US-5.8/US-5.1).

CertificationApproved.description: A leader approved a claim. Consumed by Contributions & Scoring (Unit 7) for auto-award (US-6.5): `points` is the per-certification value frozen onto the claim at approval (BR-V6), credited to `groupId` (the group the member chose at submission, US-5.4). `idempotencyKey` is identity-derived so a consumer retry cannot double-award (Events precedent).

memberName.description: Denormalised member name so Contributions writes it onto the point-ledger row directly, instead of relying on its member projection (which may be unpopulated for older members).

submittedAt.description: Claim submission timestamp — added 2026-08-07 (Unit 7 DL13) so Contributions attributes cert points to the SUBMISSION quarter (US-6.12). Additive; bundled in the Unit 7 coordinated redeploy.

expiresAt.description: Frozen at approval; null = never expires

CertificationRejected.description: A claim was rejected — by a leader with a reason (US-5.6), or by the system when the member left/was removed from the credited group before verification (US-5.4, `system: true`, reason 'No longer a member of the credited group'). Notification trigger only; no points implications.

CertificationRevoked.description: A Community Leader revoked an earned certification (US-5.8). The badge is removed; the member is notified with the reason; points are retained.

CertificationExpiringSoon.description: T-14-day expiry notice (US-5.1), emitted exactly once per holding by the daily sweep (mark-before-emit, BR-X2 — the failure direction is a lost notice, never a duplicate).

CertificationExpired.description: The daily sweep expired a holding at its frozen expiresAt (US-5.1). Badge removed immediately; points retained; resubmission allowed (the duplicate check treats Expired like Rejected).
